2126329681452335235.en_summary: Mark Cuban suggests researching legislation to standardize nationally all healthcare claims and contracts (just change the names and numbers) as a first step to reducing HC costs. Positive step whether moving to M4A or not. Tags @Alison_Galvani @AbdulElSayed @HawleyMO @BernieSanders @SenWarren @mattyglesias @matthewstoller @AOC.
